features: Wireless Smart Projector The smart projector has built-in WiFi 6, faster transmission speed and lower transmission delay. The projector easily connects to smartphones, laptops and other devices in less than 5 seconds for fast and stable projection of videos, games, and more.

【180° Rotatable Mini Projector】The projector base comes with a 180° rotatable bracket that allows the projector to point in a variety of directions, including wall to ceiling. You can view at any angle from 40 to 130 feet with a clear image on the screen.

HD Projection Screen The movie projector supports 4K 1080P and offers a 40-130 inch projection screen with an optimal projection distance of 5 feet. You can easily get the best projection screen with the automatic horizontal keystone correction function.
